sequence.title: The Final Exchange
sequence.objective: The most memorable 30 s: burnout, Gojo's gamble, Thragg's will, the race between Thragg's fist and Gojo's repair; one slow motion; decisive impact into silence.
sequence.logic: Seq 6 ends with the domain's two pre-set seconds spent and both men in mid-air at the west corner. S7-01 to S7-03 are a master angle and two overlapping angles of the same real second (map: screen 0-4 s = real 0-1 s). Burnout is shown by the absence of Limitless (R9): Gojo, who has floated all film, falls and skids, and there is no refraction ripple anywhere. Thragg drops too: the Blue pin that held him dies with the domain, and his flight is still lost to the flood. Both are visibly spent. Gojo is bloodshot, torn at the shoulder and breathing hard. Thragg is one-armed, his flank flayed, his ear torn and his lung ruptured; he bleeds from the nose, ears and tear ducts and his pupils are unequal. That is the R8 after-effect: CREATIVE, will rather than recovery, and nothing resets. S7-04 is the decision ('Shibuya mode'). His hand rises to his temple for the repair, the Seq 5 gesture, and stops: the repair compounds the brain damage that ended Shinjuku, and the target looks frozen. He gambles on a physical finish (G1-33, G2-40). S7-05 and S7-06 (real 1-5 s, near real time): Gojo walks in while Thragg's struggle plays out (clawing, head jerks, doubled vision converging); this is his will. The Six Eyes tell Gojo where Thragg is, not when he will move (R5), so the lunge in S7-07 comes unannounced. The domain lag throws it a hand's breadth off and it craters the asphalt. The shard it throws (S7-08) cuts Gojo's cheek, paying off the Seq 2 plant in which the same shards hung. Thragg reads the evidence correctly: the man walked instead of floating, and he bleeds, so the barrier is off (S7-09). Gojo, knowing what Thragg saw, starts the roughly one-second repair, and his nose bleeds. From here it is a race. Thragg goes for the head, because Seq 4 taught him that a healer must be destroyed whole. Gojo's reinforced parry knocks the blow wide (S7-10), but Thragg takes the arm (S7-11, the Oliver precedent). Gojo cannot heal it while repairing (ch 226 trade-off, G1-38) and chooses the repair. The tear costs Thragg the fraction of a second the repair needed. Thragg's final straight (S7-12, S7-13) is total commitment: no guard, and the Purple wound turned toward Gojo's free hand. THE slow motion runs S7-13 to S7-15 (real 6.0-6.4 s). The repair completes and the nosebleed spurts. Infinity resumes on its own, near fragments stop while far ones keep drifting, and the fist stops 1 cm from the eye in the S2-02 composition. Two fingers slide into the open flank. In S7-16, Red detonates inside the chest, aimed down and east, away from the lit city behind Gojo. There is no skin barrier, and the heart is destroyed (R6; T1-34 #141). The mix cuts to silence on the impact frame. In S7-17 the shockwave crosses the intersection in silence: the backwash parts around Gojo, and the ground heave kicks the mast out of its footing and over into the crater onto Thragg. S7-18 holds the wide silhouette. Counterfactual: remove the Purple flank wound, the domain lag, Gojo's choice to save the repair or the forearm parry, and Thragg's fist lands on a burned-out skull. Strike variety: a low ground-skimming lunge, a rising straight, a twisting tear and a full-body straight, each with its own angle and lens. Screen direction: Gojo is screen-left facing right throughout; Thragg is screen-right attacking right to left. The only moves along the axis away from that are Gojo's motivated skid west and Thragg's blast-back east. Positions: Gojo x=-7 (y=3) to x=-6.6 (skid), then x=-3.5 (walk), then x=-6 (skid back to the mast). Thragg x=+1 (y=2, then on his knee), then x=-2.6 (lunge), then x=-5.0 (final drive), then x=-2 (thrown into the crater).
sequence.music_cue: Out of Seq 6's reversed shatter, MUSIC RETURNS (S7-01 f8) as isolated piano-like tones, one every second or so, over the dust, with no pulse. It carries through the burnout, the decision and the walk (S7-01 to S7-05), with a low string harmonic entering under the walk. It SWELLS from S7-06 f30 as a low pulse fades in under Thragg's coil, accelerating. A HIT on the lunge's contact frame (S7-07 f12) drops in the 150 BPM ostinato, with both motifs colliding: Thragg's descending minor third against Gojo's rising fifth. The ostinato thins under the two reactions in S7-09 and peaks through the parry and the tear (S7-10, S7-11), with no brass on the tear. It DROPS OUT 2 frames before the slow motion (S7-12 f22). The slow motion stretches ONE chord (an event SWELL at S7-13 f0) across S7-13 to S7-15, with no rhythm. Under it, slowed heartbeat and breath, the soft repair chord, and Infinity's stalled swell and glassy ring at the stall (S7-15 f12). There is a HARD CUT TO SILENCE on the Red impact frame (S7-16 f3); only the final_impact transient lands. SILENCE holds through the silent shockwave (S7-17, no SFX at all) and the wide silhouette (S7-18), where the only sound is a faint high ring: Infinity's ring tail, at very low gain.
sequence.state_out: Gojo: standing at the west corner, x=-6, y=0, on a blast-shadow tongue of intact asphalt on the crater's west side; facing east; eyes narrow (blindfold at his neck, hair loose); injuries jacket_torn_shoulder, bloodshot_eyes, cheek_cut, forearm_lost (left, at the elbow, raw), nosebleed; Limitless restored and Infinity up; spent. Thragg: on his back in the crater beneath the toppled mast, x=-2, y=0; facing up; cape torn; injuries mouth_blood, torn_suit, cracked_ribs, chest_burn, forearm_lost, flank_flayed, ear_torn, lung_ruptured, nosebleed, ear_blood, eye_blood, chest_destroyed; heart destroyed, motionless, dying. Silence.

shots.prompt_core: High wide shot looking north over a ruined, evacuated eight-lane intersection at storm-dark dusk. Broad shafts of warm evening light slant down from the left through a torn hole in the cloud deck, dust drifting through them. A shallow crater sits in the centre of the street; a bent traffic-light pole with its arm sheared off stands on the left corner. Smoke columns rise over a clean-cut channel through distant towers on the right. Two small figures drop out of the air: on the left, a tall white-haired man in black falls three metres beside the pole and skids on landing; on the right, a massive man in white and crimson falls onto one knee. Faint specks of starlight fade from the air like embers.
shots.animation_notes: The fighters are small, so keep their silhouettes clear against the lit dust. Gojo's fall must read as gravity for the first time in the film: hair and the loose blindfold lift on the drop, and his legs bend on contact; no float, no deceleration. Thragg drops heavier and slightly crooked, because the torn ear lists him. Void embers on 1s, fading over 8 frames. Dust in the shafts drifts slowly west to east; keep it continuous (C.tg) so it matches across the overlapping angles of S7-02 and S7-03.

A tall, lean man in a black high-collared uniform drops into frame from above, his snow-white hair loose over his forehead and a black cloth blindfold hanging around his neck. His black shoes strike the street and skid on grit, knees buckling into a half-crouch, one hand flung out for balance with fingers splayed. The camera tilts up to his pale face: vivid narrowed blue eyes, bloodshot, breathing hard; his jacket torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder. No glow and no distortion around him. shots.animation_notes: Gojo on 1s for the drop and skid, 2s for the settle. He has real weight for the first time: knees absorb the drop, a heel slides, his torso pitches forward and he catches it. The burnout cue is the drop and the absent ripple; do not use dust or grit touching him as a cue (harmless dust reaches him anyway).

His right knee slams onto the cracked floor of his landing crater and a small star of cracks bursts out from it. f6-9: his only hand slaps down flat. f9-28: hold on his condition. His left forearm is gone at mid-forearm, the stump cauterised. His left flank is flayed raw from armpit to hip, the left ear is torn away and the side of his neck is bloodied. Map: screen 4-10 s = real 1-5 s, near real time. f0-8: Gojo straightens up into frame from the crouch, exhaling. f8-14: he lifts his right hand and flexes the fingers. Nothing happens: no ripple, no hum of Limitless. This is burnout. f14-20: the hand drifts toward his temple with two fingers extended, the same gesture as his Seq 5 brain refresh, and stops a few centimetres short. f20-26: he lowers it. The repair costs brain damage, and the thing 8 m away looks frozen, one-armed and drowning in its own lung. f16-34: his eyes narrow on Thragg. The decision is made: he will finish him by hand.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo's hand rises toward his temple, then lowers. No repair. He'll finish this by hand.
shots.prompt_core: Close-up of a tall pale man with loose snow-white hair falling over his forehead, a black cloth blindfold hanging at his neck and a black high-collared uniform torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder; his eyes are vivid blue and bloodshot. He straightens up breathing hard, raises his right hand and flexes the fingers, looking at them. Nothing happens: no glow, no distortion. His hand drifts toward his temple with two fingers extended, stops a few centimetres short, and lowers. His eyes narrow toward the right of frame in cold decision. Behind him, out of focus, a bent traffic-light pole and dark ruined towers; a shaft of warm evening light from the left with dust drifting through it.

tactical.intent: Kill cheaply: a physical finish on a target that looks frozen, without spending the brain-damaging repair ('Shibuya mode', R9).
tactical.read: Thragg is lagging, one-armed, lung-ruptured and down on a knee. Strong beings can wake at any moment, so it has to be now.
tactical.outcome: He banks the repair and commits to walking in without Limitless.
tactical.learned: Burnout is total: no Infinity, no Blue, no Red, no teleport, no floating.

Blindfold at his neck, hair loose, eyes bloodshot. This is the 'choice' beat the whole ending turns on: hold the last 18 frames on the narrowed eyes.

shots.action: Slow motion. Real time 6.23-6.40 s across 72 frames. f0-12: the fist covers most of the last few centimetres, then 15% more, then crawls, and the compressed air ahead of the knuckles ripples. f12: the stall. There is no contact flash. Thragg's shoulder bunches as his body outruns his fist. f12-36: the fist hangs 1 cm from Gojo's eye, exactly as in Seq 2. Grit and concrete fragments hang in the gap, jittering. This time the eye is uncovered, bright blue and narrowed, with blood under the nose (the cheek cut is on his far, left cheek, out of this profile). f36-56: the camera tilts down along Thragg's arm, past the torn shoulder of his uniform, to the raw flank. f48-60: the precise moment their strategies intersect. Two fingers of Gojo's remaining hand slide between the broken ribs into the open wound that Hollow Purple made. f60-72: a tight crimson point ignites inside the wound and jitters, its light glowing through the torn tissue.
shots.animatic_caption: The fist stops 1 cm from his eye, as in Seq 2. Two fingers slide into the open flank.
shots.prompt_core: Slow-motion extreme close-up in exact profile. On the left, a pale face in right profile with loose white hair, a narrowed bright-blue eye and blood under the nose; on the right, a huge crimson-gloved fist slowing to a stop a finger's width from the eye. In the tiny gap, grit and concrete fragments hang motionless, each jittering slightly, and the background bends faintly through the gap. No glow, no shield, no flash. The camera tilts down along the attacker's straining arm to his raw, flayed left flank, where two fingers of the white-haired man's hand slide between broken ribs into the wound, and a tight crimson point of light ignites inside, glowing through the flesh.

shots.action: Full speed again. Real time 6.40-7.15 s. Map: screen 23-30 s = real time. f0-2: the crimson point jitters inside Thragg's ribs, red light bleeding out through the raw flank. f3: CONTACT. Red detonates inside his chest. One impact frame flashes, and the soundtrack cuts to total silence on this frame. A hard crimson-white cone bursts out through his right chest and back, angled down and east, away from Gojo and away from the lit city. f4-10: his body is hurled away down and east, his chest blasted open and smoking; his fist hangs in the air for a frame before following. f8-18: his back hits the street and he ploughs east as the asphalt erupts into a crater around him. Gojo stands unmoved, his bloodied hand coming back to his side. The pressure front flows around him, and the chunks flying back at him hang in the air short of him.

His body is hurled away down and to the right, chest blasted open and smoking, and slams onto its back on the street, ploughing a crater as the asphalt erupts. shots.prompt_core: Extreme wide, steep high-angle shot over a ruined intersection at storm-dark dusk. A crimson-edged pressure ring races outward from a fresh crater at the left corner, a torus of dust hugging the ground. Abandoned cars and lamp posts are flung outward, slabs of the crater rim thrown in every direction, windows bursting in a ring across the facades. A bent traffic-light pole is torn from the crater's edge, spins through the dust and crashes down across the crater over a dark shape lying on its back. On the crater's left side a tiny dark standing figure is untouched, a ring of hurled chunks hanging motionless around him. Warm light shafts from upper left, smoke columns, clean-cut towers far right.
